aurinkouuni: A solar oven: an oven that heats up from the sun. It needs no electricity, gas or wood.
grilli: A grill: a device for cooking food outdoors, usually with charcoal or wood.
heijastaa: To reflect: light hits a surface and bounces off in another direction. A mirror reflects light.
asiakas: A customer: a person who buys a product or a service.
suurennuslasi: A magnifying glass: a lens that makes small things look bigger. The sun can heat the spot under it until it is very hot.
hätänumero: The emergency number, 112. You call it when someone is in danger or needs help fast.
tulva: A flood: there is too much water, and it covers the ground or goes into houses.
ensiapu: First aid: the first help for a person who is hurt or sick, before a doctor or an ambulance arrives.
ammattikoulu: Vocational school: a school where you study for a specific job. You learn theory and practical work.
VPK: A volunteer fire brigade. People help with the fire brigade's work, often without pay.
pantti: Deposit: money you pay for a bottle or a can. You get it back when you return the bottle or can to a shop.
panttikuitti: A deposit receipt: a paper that shows how much deposit you have returned. You can use it as money or a discount in the shop.
kesätyöntekijä: A summer worker: a person who works only in the summer.
kierrätys: Recycling: old things are made into new things. This creates less waste.
logistiikka: Logistics: the work of moving and storing products so they are in the right place at the right time.
ainesosa: An ingredient: something that a food is made of. The ingredients are listed on the package.
mekanismi: A mechanism: the parts of a machine that move together and do the work.
